_comment: Surfaces Grok's native subagents as Herdr panes. Only Herdr's own CLI and jq are used; there is no custom program in the path. Inert outside Herdr, because HERDR_PANE_ID is only set inside a pane.

hooks.command: [ -n "$HERDR_PANE_ID" ] || exit 0; ev=$(cat); id=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentId); case "$id" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; type=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentType); reg="$HOME/.grok/herdr-subagents"; mkdir -p "$reg"; printf %s "$ev" | jq -r '"\(.subagentType)\n\n\(.description // "")"' > "$reg/$id.txt"; pane=$(herdr pane split "$HERDR_PANE_ID" --direction down --no-focus | jq -r .result.pane.pane_id) || exit 0; case "$pane" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; printf %s "$pane" > "$reg/$id"; herdr pane report-agent "$pane" --source custom:grok-subagent --agent "$type" --state working >/dev/null 2>&1; herdr pane run "$pane" cat "$reg/$id.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

[ -n "$HERDR_PANE_ID" ] || exit 0; ev=$(cat); id=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentId); case "$id" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; type=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentType); reg="$HOME/.grok/herdr-subagents"; [ -f "$reg/$id" ] || exit 0; pane=$(cat "$reg/$id"); herdr pane report-agent "$pane" --source custom:grok-subagent --agent "$type" --state idle >/dev/null 2>&1; case "${GROK_HERDR_KEEP_SUBAGENT_PANES:-}" in ""|0|false|off|no) herdr pane close "$pane" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; rm -f "$reg/$id" "$reg/$id.txt"; exit 0
